lesson: Tiny candles at the high for over an hour, then a fast break lower from 7770 to 7730. Patience paid; the wicks told the damage.
rule: Stall at the high (60 min range 10 pts or less, 2+ taps) then a 5m close below it: puts. Hold SPX, no trims. Target 50% of the day's swing
evidence: Backtest 59 days: 8 stall breaks, 7 hit +10 pts, +35 pts. Oct 21 low 7731 vs target 7736

lesson: Bought near the 7731 low after the flush swept the 50% of the day's swing, sold near the high at 15:51 ET.
rule: After a stall break hits its target, a 5m close back above the 50% level is a reversal watch
evidence: Belle fired calls at 15:20 ET, about 18 pts late

setup: Calls stopped on pullbacks then ran
lesson: Three calls were stopped on the 12:15 ET dip and later ran +160% to +247%.
rule: SPX stops need room: no $50 trail cap on runners, test the midpoint price for SPX stops
evidence: Oct 16 to 21: SPX stopped first in 5 of 6 alerts where both lost

lesson: The best move of the day was the morning puts and it was caught.
rule: Trade the morning first leg with the flush when it breaks a key level

lesson: Calls were up 25% on the bounce after the first leg down. Should have sold at the 50% retracement of the leg.
rule: Reversal against a 30+ pt first leg: take profit at the 50% retracement of the leg, do not wait for a full retrace
evidence: Backtest 59 days: legs of 30+ pts retraced 50% on 29 of 47 days (62%), a full retrace only 14 of 47 (30%). Oct 22: leg 56.9 pts, retraced 65%, then a new low

rule: Window 3: puts are favored, calls skipped when SPY is above PDC

lesson: 02:00 ET bearish price action set the bias. The 06:00 ET reversal did not cancel it. 10:00 ET price rejected the FVG and failed to close above the ORH: confirmation for puts. 14:00 ET bearish continuation, profit taken at the weekly open.
rule: Read the 4H session profile first: a reversal inside the 4H does not cancel the bias. Entry = FVG rejection plus a failed close above the ORH. Target the weekly open
